# Emmanuel CliniX

> Applied neuroscience clinic in Bucharest, Romania. We measure before we recommend: every plan starts from BrainMap, a qEEG map of the brain's electrical activity (30 minutes, fully clothed, no radiation, no needles, interpreted in the same visit). Non-invasive methods: neurofeedback, taVNS, tPBM, CES, psychotherapy and EmSella. Romanian site: https://emmanuelclinix.ro — English site: https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk

Clinică de neuroștiință aplicată în București. Măsurăm înainte să recomandăm.

- Address: Str. Pictor Alexandru Romano nr. 26, 030167 București, Romania
- Phone / WhatsApp: +40 790 099 070
- Email: contact@emmanuelclinix.ro
- Languages: Romanian, English
- BrainMap visit: 1,200 RON (1.200 lei) — scan, on-the-spot interpretation, psychological consultation and a PDF with recommendations. No GP referral needed.
- BrainMap is an initial assessment tool, not a medical diagnosis. The online tests are self-assessment tools, not diagnoses. Nothing on the site replaces a medical consultation.

## Services (English)

- [BrainMap (qEEG)](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/services/brainmap): map of brain electrical activity, compared with normal values for your age
- [Neurofeedback](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/services/neurofeedback): a protocol built on your BrainMap; session by session the brain learns a steadier rhythm
- [taVNS](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/services/tavns): transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation, a small clip on the ear
- [tPBM](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/services/tpbm): transcranial photobiomodulation with near-infrared light, no ionising radiation
- [CES](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/services/ces): cranial electrotherapy stimulation, a very weak current through ear clips
- [Psychotherapy](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/services/psihoterapie): regular sessions with a psychotherapist at the clinic
- [EmSella](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/services/emsella): pelvic floor strengthening in a chair, 28 minutes, fully clothed (from 250 RON / session)
- [How it works](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/how-it-works): the five-step patient journey
- [Pricing](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/pricing)

## Conditions (English)

- [Conditions we treat](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/conditions): anxiety, panic attacks, insomnia, burnout, poor focus and brain fog, low mood, migraines, chronic stress, losing control of a habit, weak pelvic floor
- [For children and teenagers](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/children): attention, sleep, anxiety, learning, screen time
- [Free self-assessment tests](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/tests): nine 2–3 minute tests with a score from 1 to 10
- [Help me choose a test](https://emmanuelclinix.co.uk/assessment)
